description: Test file for the User model in Mattermost, including unit tests for user properties, validation, cloning, and profile sanitization.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the Mattermost system with properties for user details and methods for validation and manipulation.

methods.description: Returns a map of user properties suitable for auditing.

methods.description: Prepares the user object before updating.
